title: Batch 3: isolate optional chat download failures
summary: Fault injection exposed a page-wide error from the initial dynamic-loader implementation. Candidate now catches optional chunk failures, retries at most three attempts and keeps the storefront usable.

changes.detail: Explicit asynchronous import with disposal/loading guards and bounded retry replaces the throwing dynamic loader. No production change.

validation.name: Initial chunk-failure probe
validation.detail: Blocked optional chunk produced client-side application error; evidence retained in chat-chunk-failure-probe.json. Initial candidate not deployed.
